data.name: Nine Thrones
data.detailed_description:
Nine Crowns is a party-based fantasy RPG set in an open world of rival kingdoms, ancient ruins, dangerous wilderness, and shifting political alliances.

Assemble a party of adventurers and set out into a world where your choices determine who becomes a friend, an enemy, or something in between. Explore towns, wilderness, dungeons, and forgotten strongholds while developing your characters through a class-based RPG system.

TACTICAL TURN-BASED COMBAT

Fight monsters, bandits, soldiers, and other threats in turn-based battles where positioning, equipment, abilities, magic, and party composition matter.

BUILD YOUR PARTY

Recruit companions with their own personalities and opinions. Your decisions can affect how they view you—and how they view one another.

CHOOSE YOUR OWN PATH

Quests can have different outcomes based on your decisions. Make allies, betray them, pursue wealth, act heroically, or simply do what is necessary to survive.

EXPLORE A LIVING FANTASY WORLD

Travel beyond the main story and become involved in a larger world of kingdoms, factions, trade, politics, and war. Nine Crowns combines traditional party-based adventuring with a broader strategy layer in which the world can change around you.
